sentences.text: No; for a floating-rate loan granted to an individual for a purpose other than business, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, and the case was sanctioned in March 2026. (R4, E8)
The older floating-rate foreclosure-charge direction was withdrawn and is no longer in force on 2026-11-23. (R2, E11, E15)
